name: build-a-brand
description: Back-and-forth design interview that builds a brand identity tailored to the user's own business, never copied from others. Covers touchpoints, style, and audience, then distinct directions, mockups, and a style brief.
suggestedPrompts: I want to build a brand for my new business. Can we start?
Help me rethink the visual identity and positioning for my developer tool.
Review my existing brand touchpoints and recommend three fresh creative directions.
